source: TGA, Completing Conformity Assessment for immunohaematology reagents (IHRs)
note: TGA's worked example: reagent red cells for ABO reverse grouping are Class 4 under 1.2(2). Used in pretransfusion testing, so 1.2(1) is met too, but its paragraph (b) excludes a device mentioned in 1.2(2).
